title: rto-02: put rebuilt ratchet_tree last in GroupInfo
description: draft-ietf-mls-ratchet-tree-options-02 §4 (L326-328): when a signed GroupInfo carries ratchet_tree, it MUST be the last extension. Observer::group_info (crates/mimi-mls/src/observer.rs:941-949) prepends it per decision mimid-1wgh.4.46, so a PartialGroupInfo from a conforming committer that also sends external_pub fails signature verification. Change to append; update module doc (observer.rs:37-40) and method doc (:907-909); supersede mimid-1wgh.4.46. Hub unaffected today (hub/update.rs:430-439 refuses embedded trees); the gap is in the library API. Note OpenMLS (commit_builder.rs prepends) and mls-rs with GREASE violate the -02 rule, see possible WG finding.
acceptance_criteria: Add the missing [external_pub, ratchet_tree] rebuild case to tests/observer.rs (mimid-1wgh.4.64 part 2), with an independent oracle: a GroupInfo produced and signed by mls-rs (non-GREASE), not mimid's own output.
notes:
2026-11-02: filed the scope/interop problem with the -02 must-be-last rule upstream: https://github.com/mlswg/mls-ratchet-tree-options/issues/7 (options: bind every committer, or carry ratchet_tree's index in PartialGroupInfo). If option 2 is adopted, this bead's fix changes from 'append' to 'reinsert at index'.
2026-11-02: merged duplicate mimid-z96e. Extra items from it: (1) check whether mimid ever signs a GroupInfo itself (committer side) with OpenMLS's default order, which prepends ratchet_tree; if so that GroupInfo must also put it last (unverified). (2) cite -02 instead of -01 in the group_info doc comment ('preceded by').
close_reason: Observer::group_info appends ratchet_tree (rto-02 §4). Regression case [external_pub, ratchet_tree] added to tests/observer.rs with mls-rs (no grease) as signing oracle; failed before the fix. Committer side unaffected: Member's GroupInfo is exactly [external_pub]. All six gates pass.
